_meta.title: Rough mapping: public human pelvis/thorax/X-factor/arm/elbow/wrist references -> Unitree G1 joints (v5 env) and v4_power names
_meta.status: ROUGH. Names, ranges and actuators READ from the XMLs; axes/signs FK-checked; the human->G1 correspondences are assumptions unless an entry says otherwise.
_meta.g1_frame: G1 faces +x in its own frame, +y left, +z up. v5 LH golfer: body yawed +90 deg (faces +y), physical RIGHT side toward the target = LEAD side (right_* = lead). v5 RH: yawed -90 deg, left_* = lead.
_meta.conflict_with_older_docs: docs/HANDEDNESS.md and the trajectory file state env right_* = TRAIL arm. That holds for the old simple/v4 env (right_* motors = club-hand arm for a RH golfer). In v5 (physical G1 sides) right_* is the LEAD arm for a LEFT-handed golfer. Always choose side by role through env/v5_body.py lead_trail(handed).

lh_mirror_rule.summary: Reference channels are in golfer ROLES (lead/trail). Pick the physical side with lead_trail(handed). Yaw and roll joints (waist_yaw, waist_roll, shoulder_roll, shoulder_yaw, wrist_roll, wrist_yaw) flip sign between handedness (and between the physical sides of one body); pitch joints (shoulder_pitch, elbow, wrist_pitch, waist_pitch) do not. x_factor/pelvis (RH convention + toward target) are negated for LH. The v5 XMLs already mirror right-side roll/yaw ranges, so an exactly mirrored pose is q_right_roll_or_yaw = -q_left.
lh_mirror_rule.status: rule restated from HANDEDNESS.md and checked against the XML range mirroring and FK; not exercised in a training run

weak_spots: pelvis has no joint in v5

waist_yaw.axis: z of waist_yaw_link (+ = CCW from above, FK-checked)
waist_yaw.rule: waist_yaw_rad = +x_factor_rad (RH golfer), -x_factor_rad (LH golfer); x_factor in the reference RH convention (+ toward target)
waist_yaw.status: UNVERIFIED sign vs a real env run; magnitude: top -61 deg, impact -14 deg (derived) is well inside +-150 deg
waist_yaw.note: v5 address waist_yaw ~ -1 deg (LH_105) so the x_factor=0 address assumption is fine. Absolute thorax -103 deg exceeds nothing here because it is pelvis-relative.

pelvis_rotation.rule: world yaw of the free base relative to address heading: d_yaw = +pelvis_deg (RH) / -pelvis_deg (LH) about world z (LH G1 is yawed +90 deg, LH backswing = CCW = +z)
pelvis_rotation.status: UNVERIFIED. v5 has no pelvis yaw joint; pelvis turn comes from hips + ground reaction. g1_golf_env.py (old env, cannot be read as v5) adds a hinge named pelvis_yaw (+-1.6 rad); v4_power has none.
pelvis_rotation.note: Use as a reward target on measured pelvis heading, not as a joint position target.

waist_pitch.rule: + = forward lean (FK: shoulders move +x and down); hold the address value

waist_roll.rule: + = about +x: G1-left shoulder rises (FK); lateral bend sign flips LH vs RH

arm_to_trunk.status: UNVERIFIED: Zheng 'arm to trunk' plane/definition not verified; elevation assumed sagittal and trunk-relative (G1 shoulder is distal of the waist joints, so trunk-relative is natural)
arm_to_trunk.note: negative pitch = forward flexion (FK: q=-1.5 rad puts the upper arm horizontal forward). Lead top 90 -> -85 deg, impact 35 -> -30 deg. Trail top 43, impact 23.
arm_to_trunk.roll_yaw_note: shoulder_roll (+ abducts left arm; right-side range is mirrored) and shoulder_yaw carry the plane tilt; no public channel; do not constrain. Roll/yaw/wrist roll/wrist yaw flip sign between mirrored sides.

elbow.status: ROUGH, FK-derived from link origins (+-~10 deg); Zheng flexion definition unverified; lead top 58 -> q 0.40, impact 34 -> 0.84; trail top 130 -> -0.91, impact 40 -> 0.73
elbow.note: pitch joints do not change sign LH vs RH. Range -1.047..2.094; trail top 130 deg flexion needs q=-0.91 (inside range, near the limit). Flexion is NOT monotone in q above ~1.4.

fk_table.linear_fit: flexion_deg = 80 - 55 * q_rad (valid for q in [-1.05, 1.0]; flexion rises again beyond q ~ 1.4)

candidates: {S}_wrist_roll_joint (axis x) is forearm roll, not hinge

stock_torque_nm.source: env/v5_body.py STOCK (read); docs/V5_STAGE0_REPORT.md: the 5 N*m limits were binding

wrist_hinge.rule: hinge magnitude w = 90 - interior; lead top w=-4, impact w=-75 (release 71 deg); trail top 15, impact -28 (release 43). Which joint carries the cock depends on forearm roll and hand frame
wrist_hinge.status: UNVERIFIED which of pitch/yaw is the hinge and the sign (FK at wrist_roll=0: pitch moves the hand in the vertical plane of the forearm, yaw in the horizontal plane; the golf grip orientation determines which is the cock plane). Use magnitude and timing only.
wrist_hinge.note: Old g1_poses.json (another env) has wrist_yaw ~ 89 deg at address, i.e. that env used yaw for the grip rotation; not verified for v5.
